message: The other day, I realized my smoke alarm was chirping like a bird with a sore throat. Instead of feeling annoyed, I decided to make it a little family event. We gathered in the kitchen, checked our escape plan, and even practiced our fire drill—it turned into a fun little adventure! Sometimes, just turning a routine task into something cozy can make preparedness feel less like a chore. How do you make safety practices a bit more enjoyable at home?
